task: Establish an isolated, reproducible, fail-closed historical A/B replay and usage measurement tool for modular role prompts.
outcome: After the user runs the role-prompt A/B replay, the terminal shows bytes, estimated tokens, known-dispatch and provider-cache availability, finding comparisons, and a final PASS or INCONCLUSIVE result for both arms of each pinned sample. Unreconstructable historical input is reported as INCONCLUSIVE, while production Story review-run, finding, pass, and lifecycle-evidence counts remain unchanged.
facts: Story 1 fixed the Prompt Contract, role-module boundaries, and measurement baseline.
Story 2 core/prompt-envelope provides pure assembly and completeness semantics; the production agent_prompt handler persists metadata, so the experiment must not call that write handler.
prompt-contracts and prompt-measurement define canonical JSON, digests, bytes, estimated tokens, repetitions, and availability semantics for read-only reuse.
usage-ledger defines normalized provider-reported and unavailable semantics for read-only reuse; the experiment ledger is separate and has gateEvidence=false.
Existing historical lab reviewer assets lack seeded and adjudicated critical/high finding ground truth across the three required classes, so they cannot serve as a valid corpus.
Provider usage may be unavailable for offline historical samples; it must remain unavailable rather than fabricated, and real dispatch is not a prerequisite that this Story may invent.
An independent scope review confirmed that four checklist items completely cover Story 3, exclude Stories 4 through 7 and production evidence writes, and introduce zero scope gaps or drift.
constraints: Experiment writes must remain completely isolated from production Story evidence and must not write review passes, findings, review runs, or lifecycle evidence.
Historical material and both arms must be pinned by digest so the same input can reproduce measurements and finding comparisons.
Assembled bytes or token estimates must never be presented as provider usage; unobservable dimensions must remain unavailable.
Unreconstructable historical material, a missing arm, missing adjudication, or insufficient samples must fail closed as INCONCLUSIVE.
Story 3 does not enable incremental policy, migrate active or complex roles, or strengthen the budget gate.
Referenced decision documents and core source files are read-only inputs to this Story; the implementation reuses their published semantics.
